verdict.rationale: The evidence only states performance ceilings: up to 240 FPS, 60 FPS at 4K, and resolutions up to 4K with 4:4:4 color. Nothing documents quality adapting to a lagging link or user-adjustable resolution and frame-rate settings. A community note about smooth play over 4G describes general performance, not a documented adaptive mechanism or user control.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
